newsitem.title: CHINA: HK dollar slightly firmer, overnight rate eases.
newsitem.headline: HK dollar slightly firmer, overnight rate eases.

text.p: * Hong Kong dollar stabilizes at slighly firmer levels.
* Majors sidelined as traders await U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's congressional testimony later today.
* Regional currencies were firmer on profit-taking after the dollar's recent sharp rise and amid upbeat official comments. Strength in the regionals helped underpin the Hong Kong dollar.
* "People are not so nervous now that we have not breached (the psychologically important) HK$7.75," said one trader.
* Comments by Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka that Japan will keep in close contact with other Asian economies to monitor currency stability also was deemed helpful.
* Money markets quiet. Hong Kong overnight rate eases. Traders see no sign of intervention by the monetary authority.

* Spreads of Hong Kong Exchange Fund Notes widened versus Treasuries. "Spreads should be widening, because Hong Kong is now classed as an emerging Asian exotic after intervention," remarked one trader. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843-6371
